skill.name: project-versioning
skill.description: Records project versions with proper versioning, changelog, and git tags. Use this skill when user wants to document a stable version of the project.

steps.action: Analyze the changes made since the last version
steps.details: Review git log, changed files, and user requirements to determine the version number

steps.action: Determine version number using semantic versioning
steps.details: Major version for breaking changes, minor for new features, patch for bug fixes
Use 'git add -A' and 'git commit -m' with descriptive message
Use 'git tag -a v{x.x.x} -m' to create an annotated tag
Create VERSION_v{x.x.x}.md with release date, version number, status, features, fixes, improvements, changed files, rollback commands, and test results
Add and commit the changelog file

steps.action: Update the tag to include changelog
steps.details: Delete old tag and recreate it to include the changelog commit

success.message: Project version v{x.x.x} has been recorded successfully

examples: 用户说：'记录项目' → 系统分析变更，建议版本号，等待确认，执行记录操作
用户说：'这个版本很稳定了，帮我记录一下' → 系统执行记录流程
notes: Always present a plan to the user before executing
Wait for user confirmation ('同意') before proceeding
Include rollback commands in the changelog
Keep the changelog in Simplified Chinese (as per project language)
